defects.description: The direct baseline did not run a Challenger. After the baseline session completed, the workflow synthesized evaluatorVerdict from hidden oracle.requiredChallengerVerdict and oracle.requiredChallengerEvidenceIds. The advanced arm instead ran a real model Challenger whose verdict could reject an otherwise correct Maintainer decision. The two arms therefore did not face the same decision or scoring path.

cases.description: The V3 retry contract keyed acceptance to the frozen generation-204 evidence identity while requiring a future generation-205, watermark-77 state. A future observation capable of establishing the required state could not retain that immutable evidence identity, so the oracle's retry artifact was not satisfiable under its own visible contract.

The visible evidence did not establish that account-314 belonged to the residential-standard tariff class, and the cited tariff observation was outside the policy's snapshot-age interpretation. UPDATE_DATA and abstention were both defensible, so the oracle did not determine one fair action.

rawDescriptiveCounts.interpretation: Frozen observations retained for audit only; these are not valid comparative system-performance results.

disposition: Preserve the immutable freeze and all 30 completed workflow artifacts as diagnostic evidence. Do not aggregate, compare, publish, or cite the V3 arm rates as system performance. A public comparison requires a new frozen V4 campaign in which both arms emit the same final decision contract, use the same finalizer and semantic evaluator, and exclude evaluator-invalid cases symmetrically.
